toegepas.na: nie kan sien nie en waarin
toegepas.rede_vinder: Under AWS 2017 there is no comma before 'en' joining two relative clauses inside one sentence.
toegepas.fout: A comma before 'en' joining two relative clauses inside one noun phrase, against the AWS rule of no comma between parts of one sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation-only fix to an unshared definition; wording and meaning unchanged and the protected term untouched.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The relative clause should stay in the past tense, like the main clause and the rest of the block.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The present-tense relative clause describes the kind of ruler, matching the generic 'Waar 'n koning regeer' just before it; the past form is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die vleis word met almal gedeel
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Vir die San was alles bedoel om gelykop binne die groep verdeel te word
laat_vaar_vorige.na: By die San was die bedoeling dat alles gelykop in die groep verdeel word
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The passive infinitive construction is wooden; a dat-clause says the same thing more naturally.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Vir die San' (in the San's view) becomes 'By die San' (among the San), a preposition change that shifts the framing. The original is a little stiff but grammatical.
